reason: The mobile rule is still in app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:530-532 and the patch leaves it alone. The patch adds flexbox with `align-items: center` to `.small-action` (common/base/topic-post.scss:264-265) and removes the description's old 5px top offset, so the -5px margin now pulls the clock icon above centre. The offset is 2.5–5px depending on which item is taller, not always exactly 5px.
